en: "Curse you, wretch!!"{w}{p}"To think you would try to force your way through this Dekor by strength alone -- unthinkable!"{w}{p}"By my power as its guardian, I shall destroy you, defiled soul and all!!"{w}
note: Sphinx speaks archaically (ware/nanji); rendered formal English with "you", no thee/thou.

en: You killed the Sphinx.{w}
note: Source: korosita (killed), not kechirasita (routed).

en: "What, you would give up?{w}After coming all this way?{w}...How dull."{w}{p}"Well, do as you please."{w}
Take on the questions
note: Choice list for the Sphinx (with 2840/2841).

en: Force your way through
Give up
There is an old, crumbling pedestal.{w}
Touch it?

There is a strange mural.{w}These letters were carved into it.{w}{p}
{0E}  ┤┯├┌┷ ┗┫┷┴├┯ ┿┯┿┳┌  {0F}{w}
note: Pyroglyph glyphs kept verbatim as box-drawing characters (same string as slice 017 row 4214); only full-width spaces became ASCII. Build must render them or swap an ASCII stand-in.

en: It's the same as the 'Forsaken Painting' Lord Volms showed you.{w}But this alone isn't enough to go on.{w}{p}You had better look into it a little more before you report back.{w}
note: Narration; subject 'you' restored. 'the same as' kept literal: the source does not say whether the letters or the whole mural match the painting.

en: None who bear a good heart may proceed beyond this point.{w}
note: zenshin/akushin = good heart / evil heart (alignment gates; pairs with 2857 and the 15001 inscription).

en: There is an altar.{w}A thin layer of ash has settled all around it.{w}
Touch the altar?
{0A:0003:000F} turned to ash.{w}
None who bear an evil heart may proceed beyond this point.{w}

When differing hearts join hands,
the door to tomorrow shall open{w}
note: Inscription; source has no final full stop, none added.

en:
Written on the door in Pyroglyph are the words
'Let the Five Primal Races offer their prayers.'{w}
{0E}          *  Seat of the Leader  *          {0F}{w}
note: Seat names (10 rooms, 15020-15030) are new: translated plainly. They likely map to races (5 primal + 5 'new companions') and entering one seems to change the body (2882), but the script does not say which race; kept literal. Banner centring needs an in-game check.

en: Who will pray?
For an instant, {0A:0003:000F} felt they glimpsed a strange scene in their mind.{w}
Nothing happened.{w}
The Seat of the Leader is shining brightly.{w}
Will someone step into the Seat of the Leader?
note: za no naka ni hairu = step into the Seat.

en: Who will step in?
{0A:0003:000F} felt something strange about their body.{w}
note: Gender of the runtime party member unknown -> their.

en: The Seat of the Dragonfolk is shining brightly.{w}
Will someone step into the Seat of the Dragonfolk?
There is a sand-covered signpost.{w}

note: Sign: kuu no tabi 0GP = 'Sky Travel 0 GP' (ironic sign, likely a warp/pit trap). Box redrawn in ASCII at the same 46-char width.

en: "Ngh... What... was that beast...{w}It was just like... a mirage...{w}Where did they go... my companions..."{w}
note: Speaker is female per 2661 (kanojo); her own lines need no pronoun.

en:
An adventurer lies collapsed in the middle of the desert.{w}Her back is soaked in blood.{w}{p}On closer inspection...{w}the place where her back should be has been cleanly gouged away.{w}{p}What is more, the loss of flesh is eating further into her body.
Soon she will vanish altogether...{w}
note: 'her' from kanojo in this row.

en: "...You... are adventurers too...{w}In this desert... there's a beast... that devours space...{w}like... a mirage..."{w}{p}"My companions... all of them...{w}erased... aaaaah...!!"{w}

Were those words of pain? Or a cry of grief?{w}All you could do was watch over her last moments as she faded away before your eyes.{w}{p}Drop by drop, tears mixed with blood soaked into the sand, but in the vast desert they did not leave so much as a single stain.{w}
note: Mixed tense in source; past used throughout.

en: "...Please...{w}for my companions...{w}take reven--"{w}
note: toq... = cut-off 'totte' (take [revenge]); English cut at the same point: 'take reven--'.

en: ...Every trace of her vanished.{w}
note: subete kieta = everything vanished; read as her body vanishing entirely ('every trace of her').

en:
{0E}
              *  Sandstorm  *               {0F}{w}
note: Banner; same layout as the seat banners (source puts the \n after {0E}).

en: There is a melon that gleams glossily, like the sun.{w}
note: uri rendered 'melon' (could be gourd). New key item: Sun Melon.

en: Take the Sun Melon?

[Key Item]
You obtained the Sun Melon.{w}
There is a strange beast.{w}You can see the outline of its body, but within it is reflected some twisted space from somewhere other than here.{w}{p}Could this be the beast that devours space?{w}
Edumo Senior

"Those who have forgotten the name of Mother Earth,
and a Zefkaka the Kin of Darkness have sunk their hooks into."{w}{p}"Just as I thought, the words of Dehain were never worth heeding. My master's words alone are the truth."{w}{p}"Now then, the reprieve is over. I will wait no longer.{w}My apologies to my brethren, but I shall do as I please.{w}Starting by crushing these noisy maggots, that is."{w}{p}"Now come, my servants!{w}It is time to feed!!"{w}
note: tsukeirareta = exploited/taken advantage of -> 'sunk their hooks into'. shimobe read plural (summons monsters for the fight); source is number-neutral. Zefkaka per glossary; here a common noun for the land's god ('a Zefkaka').

en: You routed Edumo Senior.{w}
note: kechirasita = routed/scattered.

en:
"Heh... Don't think... that this is enough...
for you to escape the will of the gods..."{w}{p}"The best you can do... is pray that you never see an end steeped in despair...{w}that you get to die... before then..."{w}
note: kami no ishi -> 'the will of the gods' (number unknown; could be his own master). Clause order kept close to the source across the {w}.

en: The strange beast faded away.{w}{p}The beast's words were beyond your understanding, but at least you were able to avenge her and her companions.{w}
note: kanojo-tachi = her and her companions (companions' genders unknown).

en: Beneath the desert was a giant mole.{w}

"It's hot, mogu~ I'm gonna dry up, moguuu~{w}Something about this desert just rubs me the wrong way, I've had it, moguuuuu!!"{w}{p}"..........{w}I'll move, mogu.{w}That's it, I'll move house, moguuuu!!"{w}{p}"Is there anybody who might help me..."{w}
The mole pulled out a thick book of some kind and began leafing through it with great effort.{w}But the book did not seem to have what the mole was looking for.{w}
note: Mole not yet named; pronoun avoided (Raizam gender unknown).

en: "Mogugugu... What do I do, mogu..."{w}
The mole noticed you.{w}

"Oh, some little tiddlers turned up
right on time, mogu!{w}You lot, help me move house, mogu!!"{w}
note: chinmai no = tiny ones -> 'little tiddlers'. Mogu-no hikkoshi: Raizam's first-person 'Mogu' rendered 'me' (as slice 028).

en:
"I'm one of the Four Sages,
Raizam the Earth Sage, mogu!{w}I'm important, mogu! I won't let you say no, moguuu~"{w}
note: Raizam's first-person 'Mogu' rendered 'I'. note mark -> '~'.

en: You were forced into helping with the move.{w}
